title: Pan-Fried Cod with Slovakian Crispy Breading
description: A simple and flavorful dish featuring cod, crispy breading, and a hint of wholesome goodness.
instructions: Prepare the breading station: place flour, breadcrumbs, and salt in separate shallow dishes.
Dredge the cod fillets in flour, shaking off excess.
Dip the floured cod in breadcrumbs, pressing gently to adhere.
Heat the stir-fry oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the breaded cod and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes, until cooked through.
